# NewPipe Extractor

`NewPipeExtractor/` holds the main sources of https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipeExtractor
(commit in `NewPipeExtractor/VENDORED.txt`), GPL-3.0-or-later (see its LICENSE). They are compiled
by the `:newpipe` Gradle module, together with HyperXR's own `com.hyperxr.youtube` classes.
An APK that includes this module is a combined work and must be distributed under GPL-3.0.
